item.title: Trump counterterror strategy targets cartels, domestic extremists as threats shift beyond ISIS
item.summary: Trump's new counterterrorism strategy expands focus beyond jihadist groups to include drug cartels, domestic violent extremists and Iran-backed networks.

item.title: Iran demands respect at World Cup after Rubio vows IRGC connections won't be allowed
item.summary: Iranian FA chief Mehdi Taj demands the U.S. respect Iran's military institutions ahead of 2026 World Cup games scheduled in California and Seattle.

item.title: Family identifies 18-year-old killed in Oklahoma Arcadia Lake mass shooting: 'Loving caring person'
item.summary: Family identifies Avianna Smith-Gray as the 18-year-old killed in Sunday's Arcadia Lake shooting in Oklahoma, where at least 23 people were injured.

item.title: Argentina investigators zero in on possible origin point of hantavirus in deadly cruise outbreak
item.summary: Argentina officials say a Dutch couple may have contracted hantavirus at a landfill in Ushuaia before boarding a cruise ship that saw three deaths.

item.title: New AI brain lets robots move like humans
item.summary: Genesis AI unveils GENE-26.5, a robotic brain it says enables general-purpose robots to perform complex physical tasks with human-level dexterity.

item.title: Country music star Zach Bryan caught on camera shouting X-rated vulgar comment at fan
item.summary: Zach Bryan is going viral on TikTok after video shows the country singer shouting a vulgar comment at a fan, drawing widespread criticism online.

item.title: Georgia Senate candidate Derek Dooley says trans athlete participation undermines gains in women’s sports
item.summary: Former college football coach Derek Dooley made his stance on transgender athletes' participation in women's and girls' sports clear in an interview with Fox News Digital.

item.title: Minnesota fraudster cuts no-jail plea deal with key condition tied to alleged mastermind
item.summary: A Minnesota man avoids jail time in an $11 million Medicaid fraud scheme by agreeing to a plea deal that includes helping find his missing co-conspirator.

item.title: Rory McIlroy details the difference in emotions following each of his consecutive Masters wins
item.summary: Rory McIlroy joined the New Heights podcast to explain how his consecutive Masters wins in 2025 and 2026 carried very different emotional weight.

item.title: Astros star Carlos Correa out for the season after tearing ankle tendon during batting practice
item.summary: Houston Astros star shortstop Carlos Correa is out for the season after sustaining a torn ankle tendon during batting practice, requiring surgery.
